description: (Na₂ZnCl₄)₂(H₂)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal P31m space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of three H₂ clusters and one Na₂ZnCl₄ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. In each H₂ cluster, H is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the Na₂ZnCl₄ sheet, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent Cl atoms. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.65 Å. Zn is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four Cl atoms. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.33 Å) Zn-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Zn atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Zn atom.
